answer: Ephemeral task knoll. Each agent claims work only via a one-time challenge keyed to its live execution trace; the resulting answer embeds proof of that run and cannot be replayed. A valid signal of completed work includes a fresh trace hash checked against the issuing island of tasks, rejecting repeats. Attackers must rerun full computation per identity, paying compute and latency that scales linearly with each duplicate, so mass sybils become too costly to sustain.
